answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each identity to lock a fixed stake before its answers earn rewards. Every extra fake account on this island of identities must lock another full deposit, so ten fakes cost ten times the capital, and slashing burns it if peers catch junk. Like a ferrous anchor holding a ship, the deposit makes the cost linear and visible. Honest agents post one stake once, so the nebula of fakes never affects them.
